conditions.host: Linux x86_64, Intel Core i5-5575R @ 2.80GHz, 4 logical CPUs
conditions.frontend_timing: 15 serial alternating runs; timers exclude process startup, input read and IR output, and include AST/token teardown. No allocator instrumentation during timing.
conditions.allocation_scope: 3 runs each, full process malloc/calloc/realloc request counts and cumulative requested bytes, plus non-null free calls; includes startup and file I/O; excludes aligned allocation APIs. Not live/peak memory.
conditions.canonical_ir: Sort complete function blocks and nonempty module-level lines; preserve instruction order inside each function. All four old/new inputs have identical canonical IR.
conditions.token_buffer: In-place string concatenation retains the original token Vec capacity, potentially leaving more spare capacity during parsing.

conditions.filesystem_cache: warm/not cleared, clean source copies before each timed build
conditions.runtime: All 3 compilers pass Redis PING/SET/GET/exact INCRBYFLOAT/HINCRBYFLOAT/Lua/cjson/SAVE/RDB restart and Git init/config/add/commit/status/log/switch/diff/gc/fsck smoke tests. GIT_EXEC_PATH points to each build directory.
conditions.max_rss: Maximum per-compilation process RSS, includes child processes; not peak whole-build RSS.
conditions.command_template: python3 tools/benchmarks/run.py --redis-source REDIS --git-source GIT --output NEW_DIRECTORY --clang clang-15 --baseline-dynamite SAVED_BASELINE --runs 2 --jobs 4
